title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Plan International Ireland SQRIBE programme is located across seven locations across Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Burkina Faso, Mali, Central African Republic, and Cameroon. The intended outcome is that Vulnerable and Marginalised Children Realise their Rights to Access and Benefit from a Safe, Quality, Resilient and Inclusion-Based Education (SQRIBE). The objective of the grant is to meet [urgent] education and protection needs for children. The key activities include financial and technical support to schools and vocational centres, community sensitisation and mobilisation in relation to child rights, in particular girls’ rights, and capacity building for education stakeholders. The programme is delivered in partnership with local partners.OBJECTIVES: Objective 2.3 : Girls and boys improve their health, self-confidence and aspirations for further education/training pathwaysOUTCOMES: Outcome 2: School is a safe, inclusive, transformative and protective environment in which all children, adolescents and young people can obtain and enjoy a quality education.
